verdict.comment: Having shaped nicely at Pontefract on her return MRS TRUMP is fancied to make it 3-3 at Redcar. Little Muddy is feared most.

comments.birdiebowers: Looks on the downgrade and the addition of cheekpieces isn't enough to tempt
comments.garifullina: Two wins, including C&D, last summer; returns on a fair mark but six-month absence a query
comments.irishdancer: 16-race maiden; ended 2024 in good form on AW but opposable back from a break
comments.kranjcar: Expensive to follow but return to sprinting may help; not ruled out in a weak race
comments.ladyofthegarr: Best form at 5f but effective over C&D and running quite well when last seen; e-w shout
comments.littlemuddy: Best run for some time when midfield at Doncaster last month; down in class; considered
comments.mrstrump: 2-2 at Redcar; shaped quite nicely at Pontefract on her return to action; down in grade
comments.poshmaisie: Exposed maiden; not beaten far latest (bled from the nose) but not sure to build on it
comments.supernovasteps: Chance on her AW best and shaped OK after break last time; first realistic chance on turf
comments.ustath: More prolific on AW but ran okay back on turf last time and Tom Marquand a good booking

races.raceComment: mrstrump is marginally preferred with a score of 49.3%. Won 1 of last 6 starts, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: There may well be more to come from Rogue Dancer, but ELLAND ROAD GIRL has looked on the upgrade for her new yard this spring.

comments.autumnangel: Has had her moments at the stalls and there's little room for manoeuvre off this mark
comments.courtdrive: Little wiggle room off this mark and she'll need the breaks from the outside stall
comments.darksorceress: Found a weak Chelmsford handicap when going in on her comeback late last month; needs more
comments.ellandroadgirl: Looks to be improving and a 5lb higher mark may well be within range; holds leading claims
comments.fouradaay: Down to a career-low mark following a patchy spell but others have stronger claims
comments.gogoyubari: Will need to improve on her recent yard debut (over C&D) but this is a bit easier
comments.psychodrama: Showed the right attitude for her third yard latest; needs more if she's to follow up
comments.roguedancer: Finished last season on a high; there may well be more to come and she's shortlisted
comments.safanah: Didn't progress last backend; needs to improve if she's to take this back from a break

races.raceComment: autumnangel is marginally preferred with a score of 51.5%. Placed in 2 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Low draws advantaged around tight left-handed polytrack

verdict.comment: The vote goes to BOLD SUITOR who won over C&D last month and is much better drawn than when second of 11 back here a fortnight ago.

comments.americanstar: 15lb below last winning mark, but not running well enough to suggest can take advantage
comments.berniethebear: C&D winner, but losing run is up to 26 and he will need plenty of luck from stall 11
comments.bluejayway: Is now 0-17 and makes limited appeal
comments.boldsuitor: First and second over C&D in last two starts; better drawn than last time; major player
comments.coconutbay: Dual C&D winner, but finished well behind a couple of these in a handicap here last month
comments.fistralbeach: In good form on Tapeta elsewhere lately; drawn a bit wider than ideal but still considered
comments.marisitta: Has finished out of the frame in all 12 outings; look elsewhere
comments.monsieurfantaisie: Won over 6f here last month; no problem with the return to this trip; each-way claims
comments.mudlahhim: Two of his four wins have come over C&D, but current losing run is up to 17
comments.outreach: All three wins have come over C&D; should appreciate the return here, but is drawn widest
comments.ravenglass: First and second over C&D last month, but disappointing over 8.6f last time; drawn wide
comments.samshope: 1-17; unfortunate not to finish closer at Southwell last time but others more convincing

races.raceComment: boldsuitor is marginally preferred with a score of 56.5%, holding clear edges in better ratings over monsieurfantaisie. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 4 wins from 14 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Low draws advantaged around tight left-handed polytrack

verdict.comment: It may be worth siding with GALEL who returns to this trip for the first time since going down by a head over C&D in November.

comments.balmybreese: In the frame in classified events, but well held back in  handicaps this month; now 0-28
comments.diamondcottage: Returns to the AW for the first time since September 2023; off seven months; best watched
comments.embarked: 3-49 though has won over C&D; 13lb below his last winning mark but opposable from his draw
comments.galel: 0-9, but is 1lb lower than when beaten a head over C&D in November; interesting
comments.heerathetrack: Very best form has come on Polytrack and he has it all to do from the widest stall.
comments.letterofthelaw: 0-14 on the AW and failed to beat a rival over C&D five weeks ago; passed over
comments.lincolnsinn: 0-7 and looks on the downgrade, failing to beat a rival at Southwell last time
comments.matchanthem: Most consistent since November (114223324); his reliability counts for plenty
comments.redwalls: Five wins over 5f/6f here, but this trip and his wide draw make him hard to enthuse over
comments.riverwharfe: Won off 2lb lower over C&D in January; could make an impact if getting a good pace
comments.stoicsyd: Still 4lb below his last winning mark, but another furlong may have been preferable
comments.tillitshines: Won over C&D last month and badly drawn when well beaten a week later; could go well

races.raceComment: heerathetrack is marginally preferred with a score of 55.8%, holding clear edges in more progressive over matchanthem. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The selection is I CAN'T BELIEVE who has been placed in both starts over C&D since winning over a furlong shorter here in January.

comments.cityescape: Consistent around here this year (3311244); capable of playing a part granted a solid pace
comments.danehillstar: Has won three times this year including over C&D last time; one of the more likely winners
comments.desiderata: Sole win came over C&D and he ran well here last time, but he has refused to race; risky
comments.heretic: 11lb lower than for his successful handicap debut early in 2023 but has stamina to prove
comments.icantbelieve: Did well here at the start of the year and should appreciate the return of the visor
comments.lifeontherocks: Placed in last three starts and still 11lb below his last winning mark; should go well
comments.portnoir: Six-time winner here; losing run now 12 but in the frame ten times; shouldn't be far away
comments.riveralwen: Won at Chelmsford in November and a fair fourth over C&D a fortnight ago; frame material
comments.stardelta: 0-5 and returns from eight months off; half-brother to two AW winners; watch market
comments.strategicfortune: All four AW wins have come over C&D including last time; outside stall makes things tricky
comments.tarjamah: Made a winning debut here as a 2yo but has shown precious little since; look elsewhere

races.raceComment: portnoir is marginally preferred with a score of 60.2%, holding clear edges in more reliable profile over danehillstar. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include consistent performer, though unfavorable draw need consideration.

verdict.comment: The return of blinkers swings the vote in favour of bottomweight NORTH VIEW (nap). Topweight Ahlain is second choice.

comments.ahlain: Low-mileage filly whose AW record reads 11432; she's 2-2 over C&D; respected
comments.dancingmagic: Still a maiden but is well handicapped on best turf form
comments.dappervalley: Folded tamely on reappearance; AW is an unknown
comments.followyourheart: Record of 9-39 on AW features four C&D wins, the most recent in February
comments.invincibleaura: Weighted to the hilt but is consistent and again has frame possibilities
comments.kitarokich: Progressive this year (maiden previously), producing form figures of 131121
comments.metaverse: Possibilities off a workable mark with Doncaster reappearance under his belt
comments.nibrasangel: 0-12 since winning first two starts; enough to prove on AW/stable debut
comments.northview: Looks interesting with blinkers refitted on second run for new stable
comments.supremeking: In career-best form (over 6f) the last twice; 0-15 at 7f and beyond
comments.tigercrusade: Form dipped sharply last month, suggesting he's gone off the boil

races.raceComment: invincibleaura is marginally preferred with a score of 56.4%, holding clear edges in superior course form over followyourheart. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard To Slow) looks ideal with 1 wins from 10 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Low draws favored on polytrack, particularly in sprints

verdict.comment: Only 2lb higher than when closing out last Flat season with a win, BELIEVITANDUCAN remains open to improvement over this sort of trip.

comments.alexthegreat: Done well since wind surgery and back to form last time; this company is a bit stronger
comments.believitanducan: Won a couple of juvenile hurdles; relatively unexposed on the Flat; goes on the shortlist
comments.blenheimlad: Not achieved much in three runs on Polytrack; needs career-best back from five months off
comments.cinnodin: Two wins and a second from three runs over C&D; this mark is within range for in-form yard
comments.frenchmartini: 11-1 for the the voided Lingfield 0-60 handicap on her return 24 days ago; market useful
comments.greyfox: Spent most of career racing at around 1m; won well on comeback over 2m here last month
comments.legacypower: Market spoke his way on comeback and that has to go down as disappointing; bit to prove
comments.moelarthur: Has run well over C&D before but others have more pressing claims back from a short break
comments.orchestra: Not allowed his own way over C&D last time; one to consider for a yard among the winners
comments.tradesman: Capable off this mark but a lot will hinge on his mood and how he handles the stalls

races.raceComment: cinnodin is marginally preferred with a score of 57.8%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over alexthegreat. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard To Slow) looks ideal with 2 wins from 10 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include optimal distance and positive comments, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.
